001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.types;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.BaseSensorGhostCreator;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GhostFrequencies;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhost;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhostManager;
012
013public class RemnantGhostCreator extends BaseSensorGhostCreator {
014
015        @Override
016        public List<SensorGhost> createGhost(SensorGhostManager manager) {
017                if (!Global.getSector().getCurrentLocation().isHyperspace()) return null;
018                
019                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
020                
021                List<SensorGhost> result = new ArrayList<SensorGhost>();
022                SensorGhost g = new RemnantGhost(manager, pf);
023                if (!g.isCreationFailed()) {
024                        result.add(g);
025                }
026                return result;
027        }
028
029        @Override
030        public float getFrequency(SensorGhostManager manager) {
031                return GhostFrequencies.getRemnantFrequency(manager);
032                //return 10000f;
033        }
034        
035        @Override
036        public float getTimeoutDaysOnSuccessfulCreate(SensorGhostManager manager) {
037                return 100f + manager.getRandom().nextFloat() * 200f;
038        }
039        
040        
041}
042
